課程簡介: 本課程包含兩大主題，1) 解題思維，與 2) Python 基本語言概念。第一主題，將引導同學重自己熟悉的遊戲出發，試著去定義與分析問題，構思解題設計，並於期中發表。第二主題以幫助同學取得 ITS Python 證照為目標，依課本章節逐單元介紹各程式基本概念，並透過講解考古題，協助同學取得證照。
Brief Introduction: Two major topics, 1) Problem Solving Thinking and 2) Python Programming, are included in this course. Students in the first topic will be asked to pick a familiar game first, then try to define the problem, analyze them, and design the solutions for the selected game. The second topic will introduce the basics about Python programming and practice the ITS Python questions to help students acquire ITS Python certification.
